name: Elise von Richthofen
original_name: エリーゼ・フォン・リヒトホーフエン
source: The third daughter of a noble who is quite prideful. Despite her haughty attitude she is easily pushed around. Elise gets easily carried away when she gets flattered. Likes flashy and sparkly things. Even when not asked about them, Elise loves to go on about her "family's glorious teachings".
translation: The third daughter of a noble who is quite prideful. Despite her haughty attitude she is easily pushed around. Elise gets easily carried away when she gets flattered.
